accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

slot_registration_active_before_call.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP supplied slot (0x811) before the call

slot_readable_and_active_verified.meaning: the supplied slot has been verified as readable and active before notifyVaultSupply is called

yield_settlement_blocked_occurred.meaning: yield settlement is blocked because Gate 3 requires a successful distributableSurplus() calculation

assumptions: The Accountant is configured on the Vault as stated.
The target BLP supplied slot has no active registration before the call.

unresolved.description: The intent's ordering requirement (notifyVaultSupply only after verifying the slot is readable and active) is encoded as a required-effect condition; the report does not give a numeric or state-level definition of 'readable and active', so it is represented by a grounded Boolean.

Whether HyperCore leaves the 0x811 slot inactive is conditional and the report gives no deterministic trigger; the impact is encoded as an asserted blocked-settlement outcome without a quantified trigger.

limitations: The 'readable and active' verification is a qualitative Boolean; later code binding must map it to concrete slot-read checks.
The impact's Gate 3 / distributableSurplus() mechanism is captured only as the stated blocked-settlement outcome, not as a numeric relation.
Timing of the later reverting reads relative to registration is not quantified in the report.
